findings.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved a Conservation Corps stream restoration in Glen Canyon, thinning the willows to let light reach Islais Creek so insects such as the San Francisco forktail damselfly could return; the stream once held California roach, threespine stickleback and Sacramento sucker, and possibly steelhead.
